title: Parks After Dark 2026!
description:
No-cost family fun! 🫧 

On Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays this summer, you can enjoy music, food and games for FREE! Parks After Dark was started in 2022 and is a collaboration between the City, the San Diego Parks Foundation, the County of San Diego, Price Philanthropies and the Prebys Foundation. Events are held at five parks across the City each week. 

No registration required. More info: insidesandiego.org/parks-after-dark-offers-free-summer-fun-city-san-diego-recreation-centers
